Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent repeatedly failed to execute the search instructions provided by the Planner. Despite the Planner explicitly instructing the WebSurfer to run multiple different search queries (including "High Plains Aquifer Ogallala Nebraska shallow water table", "Keith County Nebraska aquifers...", and "Nebraska Geological Survey..."), the WebSurfer agent consistently typed the exact same query ("Ogallala Aquifer depth near Ogallala Nebraska groundwater") into the browser search bar in every turn. This lack of instruction following and failure to diversify search queries prevented the gathering of the specific localized data needed to confirm the answer, leading to a stalled investigation where the same unhelpful results were analyzed repeatedly instead of finding the specific confirmation required.
